title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A story of the mysteriously wealthy Jay Gatsby and his love for the beautiful Daisy Buchanan, set in the Jazz Age on Long Island. A classic tale of wealth, class, and the American Dream.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: The unforgettable novel of a childhood in a sleepy Southern town and the crisis of conscience that rocked it. Through the young eyes of Scout and Jem Finch, the story explores racial injustice and moral growth.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopian masterpiece set in a totalitarian society where Big Brother watches every move. Winston Smith struggles against the oppressive regime in this chilling vision of the future.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable life until the wizard Gandalf and a company of dwarves whisk him away on a dangerous adventure to reclaim their treasure from a dragon.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship. Learn the principles, patterns, and practices of writing clean code that is easy to read, maintain, and extend.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt & David Thomas
description: From journeyman to master — this classic guide to software development covers everything from personal responsibility and career development to architectural techniques.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen
description: The comprehensive guide to algorithms, widely used as a textbook in universities. Covers data structures, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, and more.

title: Design Patterns
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides
description: The Gang of Four classic that describes 23 design patterns for object-oriented software development. An essential reference for every software engineer.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: From the Big Bang to black holes, Stephen Hawking explores the mysteries of the universe in this landmark science book, making complex concepts accessible to everyone.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: An epic journey through the universe exploring the origins of life, galaxies, and the vast cosmos. Carl Sagan takes readers on a breathtaking tour of space and time.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A revolutionary look at evolution from the gene's point of view. Dawkins argues that genes, not organisms, are the true units of natural selection.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution, exploring how biology and history have defined us and enhanced our understanding of what it means to be human.
